'''JR-8 series maintenance droids''' were all-purpose [[Janitor/Legends|janitor]] units constructed to clean, refurbish, and perform light repairs. They were equipped with an internal cleaning fluid reservoir and integrated spray nozzle, and they were known to spray detergent at individuals who interfered with their tasks.<ref name="g4" />

Multiple JR-8 series droids were employed by [[Temporary Droids]], a droid rental company on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Company [[President/Legends|president]] [[Turren Lonarr]] used twenty-four of these droids to spray [[Flame beetle/Legends|flame beetle]] [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromone]] on the landing pad of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] belonging to a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] that were investigating his activities.<ref name="g4" />
